authoredNote: M60. Written from the rule, not from observed output: an anonymous class is named by a structure of its supertype, and a second anonymous class of the SAME supertype in the same file takes #2 rather than colliding. The rule follows the lane's existing per-file `given_N` counter convention (real-scala-analyzer.ts givenCounter), so the naming is rename-stable under upstream line insertions.
rationale: 402 of 18,446 scala3 files declared a duplicate anonymous name (517 collisions over 3,330 anonymous symbols). The cost was a merged graph node: CheckCaptures.scala declares four distinct anonymous_TypeTraverser classes and published all their members under one owner, 7 of 8 contains rows attributed to the wrong class, and `traverse` appearing four times under one owner collapsing to a single row after the harness's (label, target) dedupe. The first occurrence keeps the bare name so every existing pin still holds; only the collision takes a suffix. The negative half matters as much as the positive: a fourth anonymous_Runnable must not be numbered #1 again, and a DIFFERENT supertype must not be pushed to #2 by a same-supertype neighbour.

expectSymbols.name: anonymous_Runnable
expectSymbols.comment: the FIRST `new Runnable` keeps the bare name, so existing pins such as `anonymous_Runnable -> run` still hold

expectSymbols.name: anonymous_Runnable#2
expectSymbols.comment: the second `new Runnable` is DISAMBIGUATED rather than merged into the first node

expectSymbols.name: anonymous_Runnable#3
expectSymbols.comment: the third, numbered in source order

expectSymbols.name: anonymous_Other
expectSymbols.comment: a DIFFERENT supertype is a different name and is NOT numbered against the same-supertype neighbours

forbidSymbols.name: anonymous_Runnable#4
forbidSymbols.comment: there are three anonymous Runnables in this file; a fourth would mean the counter is not per-file

forbidRelationships.comment: THE COLLISION DEFECT: `extra` belongs to the SECOND anonymous class. Attributing it to the first is the merged-node bug that cost 402 corpus files their graph shape.
a different supertype must not be renumbered by a same-supertype neighbour, so this class stays bare
